title: Baroque Dancing - Lesson 7 - Pas Coupe added onto Temps de Courante & Demi Jete

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down Baroque dance steps clearly, explaining the mechanical transfers of weight and combining steps into sequences. She demonstrates from both front and back views to help students follow along.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the pas coupe and sequence of steps
Breakdown of the pas coupe step
Combining tonde courante, demi jete, and pas coupe
Practicing the sequence with back to camera

cues: Start off on the right foot
Step forward one, step forward two

steps_taught.name: Pas Coupe
steps_taught.description: Two steps passing through first position with weight transfers

steps_taught.name: Demi Jete
steps_taught.description: A small jump or step transfer of weight

what_works: Repeating the steps multiple times from different angles
Focusing on the transfer of weight rather than just counting
what_hinders: Limited space makes full movement difficult to show

quotes.text: In this video we're going to do the pas coupe.
That's not a musical way of doing things.
And that's a nice sequence for Labanotation.
